explanation: Pen, Keyboard, Typewriter, and Pencil are all instruments primarily used to directly produce or input written text. A Microphone captures sound, which may be transcribed into text, but it does not directly create written output itself.

category: Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
explanation: The Great Pyramid of Giza, Hanging Gardens of Babylon, Colossus of Rhodes, and Lighthouse of Alexandria are all traditionally recognized as four of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. The Library of Alexandria, though historically significant, is not included in this canonical list.

Each token, except 'Neptune', is a word that contains the name of one of the eight planets in our solar system (excluding Earth for ambiguity). 'Neptune' is the name of a planet itself, rather than a word containing one.
